A1.justification: Both complete 22-page PDFs describe PhySense. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F.

before.justification: v3 reports original reconstruction and sensor-placement experiments on turbulent flow, sea surface temperature, and simulated car aerodynamics, plus empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and their results, including the benchmark comparisons and supplementary analyses in Appendices B and D.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same flow-based reconstructor, cross-attention conditioning, training objective, and projected-gradient sensor-placement procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same turbulent-flow, GLORYS12 sea-temperature, and car-aerodynamics benchmarks, with identical task and test-scenario coverage throughout the appendices.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: SSPOR, VoronoiCNN, Senseiver, S3GM, and DiffusionPDE remain in their corresponding benchmark comparisons. Placement comparisons and appendix comparator sets also match.

E3.justification: Data splits, sensor counts, evaluation metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and simulation settings are identical in Section 4 and Appendices C–D.

E4.justification: Section 4.4 and Appendix D retain the same conditioning ablations, placement-initialization and transfer analyses, efficiency comparisons, learning-rate sensitivity, gradient-field evaluation, and uncertainty analysis.

E5.justification: Appendix D.3 still reports training the base model once and taking three reconstruction samplings per setting. Tables 14–15 and Appendix D.5 retain identical uncertainty-reporting practices.

E6.justification: All numerical results, rankings, and qualitative findings match, including Tables 2–7 and 12–16. No result entries were added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: Section 3's assumptions, definitions, and Theorems 3.1 and 3.5 are unchanged, as are the proofs and mathematical extensions in Appendix A.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about the two-stage framework, variance-minimization guarantees, and state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are identical. Appendix E retains the same point-wise sensing limitation and proposed extension to regional observations; Appendix F is also unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, simulation instructions, hardware/software details, and code-access information are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgment supplies no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The bibliography contains exactly the same works and text after accounting for pagination. References [19] and [41] move to subsequent pages; research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds the State Grid Ningxia Electric Power Co. Science and Technology Project to the funding acknowledgment and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer acknowledgment reflows the bibliography across pages 11–13, and the first-page arXiv stamp changes. All scientific figures, tables, equations, and appendix layouts remain visually identical.

improvement.justification: v4 adds funding attribution and makes associated administrative and pagination updates. The method, empirical evidence, proofs, reproducibility information, and limitations remain identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
